title: BetterIRC
description: A modern mod for IRC support in Minecraft
body:
# BetterIRC
BetterIRC is a mod that allows you to connect to IRC servers in Minecraft.
This is a very early release with minimum configuration.

This mod was tested on an [Ergo](https://github.com/ergochat/ergo) server.

## All messages starting with `-` are sent to the preferred IRC channel.
![basic usage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc0db1f24ec2e8b34feb452f0825302fc2bc4b01.png)

## Access commands using `$help`
![command list](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e27c32fee63b1287bbddb6c45a992d3ab94cc416.png)

## Connect to multiple channels at once
![channels](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/99ea50b3ad02645b1551539a67d0a8528efa583a.png)

## Configurable
![config screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0cb13fbf2c6b70c3c306e1e9771fe3ecd380e5f9_0.webp)

## Requires
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
- [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)

## Notice
Future updates will be 26.1+ only. They won't be ported to 1.21.10.

# Issues
You can report issues and suggest features through GitHub and Discord.

# Contributing
While this mod gets the job done, it is in a very early stage and comes with many issues. If you would like to contribute to the mod, you can tackle one of the issues below:
- There is currently no support for servers with TLS enabled. It might be an issue with how I set up my test server.
- Allow toggling the mod in-game.
- The command system is mostly hardcoded. Requires a more dynamic system.
- More config options. Reconnect attempts, better profile settings, private messaging, mention pings, custom chat/command prefix, etc.
- Easier way to switch between channels.
- Handling more IRC events. Most events are not handled, so there might be hidden desyncs.
